ext_desc.message: Fills login forms from your Marveen vault instead of the browser's own password manager.

hint_code.message: Open the Marveen dashboard, go to Accounts, and press "New pairing code". Type the 8 characters you see here.

state_paired.message: Paired. Logins on saved sites will be filled from the vault.

auto_label.message: Fill automatically when there is exactly one match

err_unknown_code.message: The dashboard does not know this code. Check the characters, or ask for a new one.

err_expired.message: This code has expired. Ask the dashboard for a new one.

err_already_used.message: This code already paired another browser. Ask for a new one.

err_unreachable.message: Could not reach Marveen at that address. Is the dashboard running?

err_permission.message: The browser did not grant access to that address, so pairing cannot continue.
